sections.title: II. Read the email, choose the best answer A, B, c or D . (1.5pt)
sections.introHtml:
From: Lan@fastmail.com

To: nick@fastmail.com

Subject: My best friend

Hi Nick,

It’s great to hear from you. I want to tell you about my best friend.

My grandma is my best friend. She’s 68 years old. She lives with our family. She was a Maths teacher at a secondary school. She likes getting up early and watering the flowers in our garden, she usually helps me with my homework. In the evening, she tells me interesting stories. She also listens to me when I’m sad. I love my grandma very much.

What about you? Who’s your best friend?

Please write to me soon.

Bye bye,

Lan

sections.title: I. Rewrite the following sentences with the given beginnings in such a way that the meanings stay unchanged. (1pt)

questions.html:
1. What is your favorite subject?

→ What subject
questions.referenceHtml:
1. What is your favorite subject?

=> What subject do you like?

questions.html:
2. There are 45 students in my class.

→ My class
questions.referenceHtml:
2. There are 45 students in my class.

=> My class has 45 students

questions.html:
3. That car belongs to Mr. Long.

→ That is
questions.referenceHtml:
3. That car belongs to Mr. Long.

=> That is Mr. Long's car.

questions.html:
4. Do you like physics?

→ Are you interested
questions.referenceHtml:
4. Do you like physics?

=> Are you interested in physics?

questions.html:
5. Let's go on a picnic this weekend.

→ How about ?
answers: going on a picnic this weekend
How about going on a picnic this weekend?
questions.referenceHtml:
5. Let's go on a picnic this weekend.

=> How about going on a picnic this weekend?

questions.html:
6. Their hair is short and brown.

→ They have ?
questions.referenceHtml:
6. Their hair is short and brown.

=> They have short brown hair.
